clips.sourceText: You join Hana at a weekend repair table near the harbour.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: This little shelf was meant to take an hour.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: A visitor places a broken drawer beside it.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Could you do this one too? I'm hopeless with tools.
clips.speaker: Peter

clips.sourceText: I can show you the first step. I can't build two things today.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: I was hoping to leave it with you. I don't want to ruin it.
clips.speaker: Peter

clips.sourceText: We start by looking. No dramatic hammering required.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: Peter labels the pieces while she explains the loose joint.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I can see what is wrong now. That is already different.
clips.speaker: Peter

clips.sourceText: Take the labels home with it. We can continue next week.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: After I moved. I thought that detail didn't matter.
clips.speaker: Peter

clips.sourceText: It might. Bring the note with you next time.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: The drawer stays intact. Her own shelf is finished by lunch.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I will bring the toolbox back on Monday.
clips.speaker: Peter

clips.sourceText: With all the pencils, if they haven't escaped again.
clips.speaker: Hana

clips.sourceText: A beginning does not have to finish the whole job.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You help Amina carry her prints to a weekend market.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That table looked much bigger in the email.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Handmade notebooks fill the table beside her.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Could I borrow this corner until I've unpacked?
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: Of course. For a few minutes.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: The market opens. The boxes are still there.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: People can't see the small prints. Those usually sell first.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: He isn't being unkind. I still need my table back.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: I need this corner for the prints now. Where can we put these?
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Under my table. Sorry, I lost track when people arrived.
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: You hold the notebooks while they move the empty boxes.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: There. I can see the blue one again.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Could we keep everything on your side of this join?
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Yes. I thought the corner was spare. I should have asked.
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: They move the displays until both can be seen.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A very small border. Already improving relations.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: A customer stops to look at the print that was hidden.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Tea when the rush slows down?
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: Yes. On your table, this time.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Making room includes keeping some for yourself.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You hear the start of your friend's birthday message.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Happy birthday, you absolute menace. No, not that bit.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: She stops the recording, then rubs her forehead.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: My sister moved away last year. We used to share a wall.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: Now I keep trying to fit a whole year into a minute.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: Turn that down. Usually. Sometimes, have you eaten?
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: She opens the recorder again, then looks at you.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Remember the cake we dropped, and blamed on the table?
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: I bought one today. Same terrible icing. Miss your half.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: This time she keeps the whole recording.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That's enough, isn't it? She knows the rest.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: Birthday call this weekend? Tell me a time that suits you.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: No rush tonight. I hope somebody has bought you cake.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: She waits a beat, then adds one last thing.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: And if they haven't, I have very strong opinions.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: The message leaves her phone. The café is closing.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Now I can miss her without editing it for twenty minutes.
clips.speaker: Niamh

clips.sourceText: Some voices already know the way home.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Isla meets you outside a small theatre during the festival.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A return came in. One ticket. Of course it had to be one.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: I've wanted to see this company since last summer.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: I asked you out. Abandoning you at the door feels rude.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: Across the road, another show is putting up its last poster.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Same corner afterwards? I want your review.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: Later, she returns with a programme folded into her coat.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I hated the ending. I've been wanting to tell you for an hour.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: I do. That poster has a very suspicious cardboard moon.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: She returns the ticket to the box office. You cross the road.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: If the moon falls down, we are applauding it.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: It does not fall. You are both a little disappointed.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Same time tomorrow? We can start with two tickets.
clips.speaker: Isla

clips.sourceText: An evening together can take more than one shape.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You listen to a community radio segment with Aaliyah.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: We are thirty seconds over. The ending is all thanks.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: She has marked the names of everyone who helped.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The easy cut is the people nobody heard speaking.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: Found the guests. Fixed the cable. Stayed to clear up.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: All the things that let me sound wonderfully prepared.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: She plays the opening again. It contains a long welcome.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I can lose the second welcome. They arrived the first time.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: She records a shorter opening, then checks every name.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Yes. Just a version of me that gets to the point sooner.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: The guest introduction can say who made the invitation.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: The list becomes part of the story of making the programme.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That sounds more like a room full of people. Which it was.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: The final version ends with two seconds to spare.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Leave those empty. We have earned a breath.
clips.speaker: Aaliyah

clips.sourceText: She takes the headphones off. Someone brings the tea.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A voice on air is rarely working alone.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You bring Oliver a book with a bookmark near the start.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Ah. A bookmark with very little travel experience.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Everyone isn't sitting on your sofa after work.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: He opens it at the bookmark, then closes it again.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: What were you hoping it would give you?
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Short stories, perhaps. A door you can close before bed.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: He chooses a slim book, without checking the price first.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Try the first page. Don't buy a promise on my account.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Then you've learned that before carrying it home.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Unfamiliar doesn't have to mean a thousand pages.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: He puts a small collection beside the book you returned.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: This one makes ordinary rooms feel slightly different.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I didn't. I went back because I wanted to.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: You read while he sorts a pile of paperbacks.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: For once, nobody asks how far you have got.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Tea's still warm if you'd like another page.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: A book can wait. Your attention is yours.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Leah has saved ten minutes at the listening table for you.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A local band left this here. They want honest ears.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: The first side is bright and busy. Leah taps the table.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Really? That's the bit I kept waiting to get past.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: She reaches for a review card, then stops writing.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I wrote 'too slow'. Maybe that only means too slow for me.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: This time she keeps her hand away from the needle.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Oh. You can hear the room around the singer.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: Still not my favourite. But I know what you stayed for.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: Mine says the drums make the room feel bigger.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: Bigger and closer. They'll think we heard different records.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: She puts both cards in the sleeve, without ranking them.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Next week, you choose the record. I will bring my objections.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: Those too. Apparently they are useful.
clips.speaker: Leah

clips.sourceText: Different ears can share the same table.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You meet Ruby by the beach with a borrowed board.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I checked the conditions again. We aren't going in today.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Me too. The forecast doesn't take personal requests.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: She sounds disappointed, too. Not apologetic for the sea.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: We could stay for breakfast, or give the morning back.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: You don't owe me a cheerful backup plan.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Once each. Mine involves getting up before the kettle.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: You carry the boards back before finding a table.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Funny. I never come here when I can't call it training.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Not this breakfast. Look at those eggs.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Absolutely. Let's check the conditions closer to the day.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: You return the board together, then part at the corner.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Thanks for saying what you wanted. Saves us both guessing.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: And I'll still be there for the spectacular falling over.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: The sea keeps its own plans. You have made yours.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A changed plan can still be a day you chose.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Wanjiku invites you to a small sewing workshop she knows.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I came back for this blue. Apparently, so did everybody else.
clips.speaker: Wanjiku

clips.sourceText: The piece on the table is smaller than the paper pattern.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Enough for the front, not for the whole bag.
clips.speaker: Zuri

clips.sourceText: I had a very clear picture of it. That may be the problem.
clips.speaker: Wanjiku

clips.sourceText: We can change the back, or wait for something else.
clips.speaker: Zuri

clips.sourceText: Put them by the window. This light is too yellow.
clips.speaker: Zuri

clips.sourceText: The colours change beside the daylight.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Oh. That looks less like my drawing. More like something I'd use.
clips.speaker: Wanjiku

clips.sourceText: Then let's mark it before either of us changes our mind.
clips.speaker: Zuri

clips.sourceText: I think I still want the first version. Is that annoying?
clips.speaker: Wanjiku

clips.sourceText: Not at all. Cloth is patient. Most of my customers aren't.
clips.speaker: Zuri

clips.sourceText: They write down the size instead of cutting the fabric.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Tea, then? I've unexpectedly kept my afternoon budget.
clips.speaker: Wanjiku

clips.sourceText: Zuri pins the drawing where she can find it again.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: You can change your picture, or give it more time.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You help Calvin collect requests before a small evening set.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: This one says, 'Something for getting through Thursday.'
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: Some Thursdays take their time leaving.
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: A woman near the back raises her hand.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That's mine. Sorry, I don't know many song names.
clips.speaker: June

clips.sourceText: No test at the door. Tell me what you want to hear.
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: Something with a little lift. I have rested quite enough.
clips.speaker: June

clips.sourceText: A little lift. We can work with that.
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: He speaks to the others, then changes the last line of the list.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I didn't expect you to take that scrap of paper seriously.
clips.speaker: June

clips.sourceText: A piano through an open window. Nothing in a hurry.
clips.speaker: June

clips.sourceText: That's a clearer request than half the song titles I get.
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: He asks the pianist for room in the last piece.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I can sit with that for a while.
clips.speaker: June

clips.sourceText: During the last piece, the paper stays folded in her hand.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Not my job to know. I gave it somewhere to sit.
clips.speaker: Calvin

clips.sourceText: You do not need the title to know what moves you.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You find a table near the food truck Marcus recommended.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: His message says: 'Ten minutes. Small job ran over.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Twenty minutes pass. Your lunch is getting cold.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Hey. I'm sorry. The small job grew several new heads.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Half an hour. Maybe forty. I should've said that sooner.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: I kept hoping I'd finish before you got annoyed.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: A real leaving message. Coat on, keys in hand.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Later, he arrives without pretending he has been nearby.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: How was the lunch I so expertly failed to attend?
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Fair. Next time I'll be here for that part.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: You're right. Don't turn your afternoon into my waiting room.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: That evening, he suggests a day and a time.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I'll tell you when I know. Not when it looks better.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: The next message contains an actual time. You can use it.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Being easy to meet starts with being clear.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You meet Mei for lunch at a hawker centre.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I'll get another portion for my dad. He loves this stall.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Her father calls just as she reaches the queue.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Are you buying lunch? Please don't get me the usual.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: Really? You've called it the best lunch for ten years.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: It is good. I am allowed to want something else.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: Mei looks at the menu as if it has changed overnight.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: What sounds good today?
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Something warm, with soup. Let me hear the choices.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: She reads two options and waits for his answer.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Got it. I won't make this your new lunch forever.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Thank you. I was beginning to feel like a standing order.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: Would you rather come here? We have time.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: If you save me a seat. I was waiting for an invitation.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: When he arrives, Mei moves her bag off the spare chair.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Now tell me what you two are having. I'm curious.
clips.speaker: Uncle Tan

clips.sourceText: We can start at the beginning of the menu.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: I thought remembering his favourite meant I knew the answer.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Knowing someone leaves room to ask again.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You meet Tahlia near the ferry wharf after her shift.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: We could take the ferry and walk on the other side.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: Oh. My version of 'a quick walk' has been growing.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: I wanted to show you a place I go when the week gets loud.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: No. It isn't going anywhere. That is most of the appeal.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: Let us check the return before we buy anything.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: You agree on a shorter route. She sets an alarm.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A sunset with a sensible ending. Very unlike me.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: Then this bit of harbour is ours for the evening.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: You find a place to sit while the ferry pulls away.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I usually look at this shore from the water.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: That I can hear you without shouting over the engine.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: When it is time to call, she gives you a little space.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Tell them the harbour says hello. No need to rush.
clips.speaker: Tahlia

clips.sourceText: Not every good evening needs a longer route.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Maya invited you to a small potluck at her flat.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Three cakes. We have accidentally planned a birthday.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: Her friend Sam arrives with an empty shopping bag.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Sorry. I thought 'bring yourself' was the whole instruction.
clips.speaker: Sam

clips.sourceText: It was! I put the food message in the wrong group.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: Sam reaches for his coat before anyone has asked him to.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I can run out and get something.
clips.speaker: Sam

clips.sourceText: Stay a second. This is dinner, not an entrance fee.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: There is rice, eggs, and enough vegetables for a small forest.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: I can chop things. Slowly, but with great commitment.
clips.speaker: Sam

clips.sourceText: The kitchen fills with small jobs and competing music choices.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I'll cover the main dishes. My invitation caused the mystery.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: Only if you mean it. I can contribute something next time.
clips.speaker: Sam

clips.sourceText: I mean it. Next time, I will send one message to one group.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: Everyone checks the order before the phone goes away.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: By dessert, nobody is counting who brought what.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: So whose birthday did we decide it was?
clips.speaker: Sam

clips.sourceText: The group chat's. May it grow wiser.
clips.speaker: Maya

clips.sourceText: A place at the table does not need a receipt.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You join Noah and his friend Ruth for a sunset walk.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: If we keep moving, we can reach the point before sunset.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: I can walk there. I can't enjoy it at that speed.
clips.speaker: Ruth

clips.sourceText: Noah slows down. The camera stays in his hand.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Sorry. I turned the light into an appointment.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: Water, somewhere to sit, and a conversation I can finish.
clips.speaker: Ruth

clips.sourceText: The reflection is good here, actually.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: You don't have to turn staying into a photography argument.
clips.speaker: Ruth

clips.sourceText: Fair. I'd like to stay. The reflection is a bonus.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: He puts the camera down while Ruth finishes her story.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Ten minutes. Back at this bench, even if the light is perfect.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: Go. Bring a picture, not an apology for being late.
clips.speaker: Ruth

clips.sourceText: He returns while there is still colour on the water.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I missed the best second. Got most of a very good minute.
clips.speaker: Noah

clips.sourceText: You leave after the story ends, not after the light does.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A good view has room for the people beside you.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: The rain has turned the pavement into a second sky.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: One small bookshop is still glowing.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Oliver's message was simple: 'A reading tonight.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: 'No homework, I promise.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: You found it. I was about to send you directions.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Three pubs and a very unreliable pigeon were my landmarks.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Just listen. That's perfectly respectable in a bookshop.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: He holds the door. Inside, wet coats smell faintly of rain.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Someone is moving a chair.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The room is smaller than you expected.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: There is no stage, only a chair between two shelves.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Hi, I'm Nora. Tea is over there. Take any seat you like.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Nora runs the shop's reading evenings.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: She folds a list once, then checks the door.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: One of our readers can't make it. A family thing.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: We'll simply finish a little earlier.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Not unless someone wants to. An empty slot isn't an emergency.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Oliver looks at the chair, then at his coat pocket.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The edge of a folded page is showing.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Possibly. It could also be a very ambitious shopping list.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: It's a page from the novel. I bring it here sometimes.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Carrying it is easier than reading it.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Thanks for asking me first.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I want to hear what it sounds like outside my own head.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I'm less keen to hear everyone wishing I'd kept it there.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: One page is plenty. They can stop whenever they like.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Is someone considering it?
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Cheers for not volunteering me.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: 'One page' sounds less terrifying than 'a reading'.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: A small beginning. One page, no questions afterwards.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: And permission to be bad at it.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I'll ask. If I can read my own words, I can say that much.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Of course. A page, no questions.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: And you can change your mind before we begin.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: This isn't an audition. Nobody here needs to earn their chair.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Oliver turns the folded page over.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The conversation pauses long enough for him to breathe.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I could try tonight. Or listen, and bring a page next time.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Both feel real now.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: All right. One page.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: If I faint, please call it an experimental ending.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: You choose a seat where he can see you.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Nora leaves the chair beside him empty.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Oliver is sharing something new.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: We'll listen, and leave the questions for another day.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: He unfolds the page. His first breath is audible.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: His first sentence is quieter than his jokes.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Every morning, the man at number twelve opened his window
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: before he checked the weather.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: 'He said a forecast could tell you about rain.'
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: 'But not what the street had decided to become.'
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: He loses his place once. Nobody rescues him.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Nobody needs to. He finds the next line.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: 'That Tuesday, there was a chair outside the bakery.'
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: 'He sat down before he found a reason.'
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: When he finishes, the room stays quiet for a heartbeat.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Then comes a small, very ordinary round of applause.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I thought silence meant it was going badly.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Turns out people sometimes listen in it.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: That's oddly specific. Much better than 'brilliant'.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I might actually believe you.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Then I'll listen.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Not hide at the till and pretend to count receipts.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Actually listen.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Nora nods and points you towards the listeners.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The spare chair can stay empty. No explanation is owed.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: We'll have a shorter evening, which leaves more time for tea.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: The next reader speaks about a kitchen.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: You watch the empty corner as the voice fills the room.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: After the reading, Oliver leans towards you.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: 'She stopped mid-sentence and started again. Nobody minded.'
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I spend ages imagining an audience that doesn't exist.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Would you like to hear the first sentence? Just you, for now.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Every morning, the man at number twelve opened his window
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: before he checked the weather.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: That's the question I wanted someone to ask.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I haven't quite earned the answer yet.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I'll bring a page next time.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Whether I read it to the room can be next time's decision.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: Coats come off the hooks. Nora tidies the books on the table.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The shop becomes a shop again.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Same time next month.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Bring a page, bring a friend, or just bring yourself.
clips.speaker: Nora

clips.sourceText: Less dramatic. More useful. Annoying, really.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: I had prepared some excellent excuses.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: At the door, he returns to something you said earlier.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Thanks for asking what I wanted before trying to fix things.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: People don't always do it in that order.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: You made the question smaller, but left the decision to me.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: One page. I can work with that.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: The rain is lighter now.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Through the window, the chair is just a chair again.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Coffee tomorrow? I won't make you review the whole novel.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: One page at a time.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: And you can tell me about something you'd like to try.
clips.speaker: Oliver

clips.sourceText: You arrived with an invitation.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: You leave with a small plan for tomorrow.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Some beginnings are one page long.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: You signed up to help at a neighbourhood photo evening.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Thank you for coming early. The chairs are winning.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Could you hold this while I check the captions?
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Two captions describe the same street in different ways.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: One says 'a place to leave'. One says 'the way home'.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Same afternoon. Different neighbours.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: The printer wants one title. I said it would be simple.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Now tidy looks rather like leaving somebody out.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Leaving was a good thing for me. Coming back is, too.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: I thought 'leave' meant you didn't want us in the picture.
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: No. I needed a larger picture. You were still in it.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Keep the part where I chose to go. It wasn't an accident.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: And keep my front step. I waited for her on it.
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: Two complete thoughts. I don't have to turn them into one.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: The phone rings. The last print slot is nearly gone.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: We can print two smaller cards, or write one by hand.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Less polish, perhaps. More room to be specific.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Let me ask. That is their choice as well.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Put hers first. People can walk towards mine.
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: Side by side. They can choose where to begin.
clips.speaker: Amina

clips.sourceText: Side by side, then. No final answer at the bottom.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Amina crosses out a word. Jonas leaves the crossing visible.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That's part of the writing, isn't it?
clips.speaker: Jonas

clips.sourceText: It is. I'll make sure the light reaches both halves.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: When the doors open, someone asks which caption is right.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: They belong to different people. Read them both.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: I thought hosting meant making everything agree.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: Tonight I mostly made sure people could hear each other.
clips.speaker: Amara

clips.sourceText: A shared room can hold more than one story.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Ruby has invited you for coffee after her shift.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: She puts down two cups. Her phone lights up again.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That's three favours before lunch. Personal best.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: No! I wanted the walk. That's sort of the problem.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: My marine biology application is due tonight.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: I've opened the form twelve times. Written my name twice.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Her colleague asks if she can cover the late shift.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I nearly said yes before she finished the sentence.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: She asks someone else. I feel awful for twenty minutes.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: I know how that sounds. Knowing doesn't quite fix it.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: The morning shift is done. The afternoon is mine.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: I've been spending it as if nobody lived in it.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Finish the application. Then walk without checking my phone.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Actually saying it makes the other answer harder to send.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: I can't cover tonight. I've got a deadline of my own.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: She sends it before adding a fourth apology.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: The reply is short: 'No worries. Good luck with it.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Oh. The world appears to be coping.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: You move to a quieter table. She opens the form.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: It asks why I want to do this. Now I sound like a brochure.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: One paragraph. Tell me where you hear me in it.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Good. I can start there. The brochure can have the rest.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: An hour. If I send you a coffee meme, ignore it.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: You take the long way around the block.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: When you return, her phone is face down.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: She presses submit, then sits very still.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: They might say no. At least they'll be saying it to me.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Thanks for not turning my afternoon into your project.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Very much. No errands on the way.
clips.speaker: Ruby

clips.sourceText: Some plans begin with a space left empty.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: Marcus asks you to help choose prints for a small show.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Photographs cover the table. One space is carefully clear.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: This one was going in the middle. First thing you saw.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: It is Elena outside her repair shop, after closing.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: She said yes to the picture. Not to the exhibition.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Her message says: 'I'd rather you didn't put it up.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I typed 'of course'. Haven't sent it. Hate that about me.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: The show's called Working Hands. Hers held it together.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Of course. I'll leave it out. Thanks for telling me.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: He sends the message. Then puts the phone down.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: She built that counter herself. Thirty years ago.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: I wanted people to see what she made. Not just my light.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: He reads the message once more, and agrees to leave it out.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Okay. A hole in the wall is better than a hole in that.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: The next afternoon, you bring Elena a print she asked for.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: For my daughter. She thinks I live behind that counter.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: I don't want strangers asking me about that day.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: You don't have to explain it. The print is yours.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: You could ask me about something I repaired instead.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: Marcus looks at the workbench, then back at her.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: That lamp. Three people told her to throw it away.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: A loose wire. Ten minutes. Don't make me sound heroic.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: A lamp, and your words. Can I show you both first?
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Write this: 'Sometimes it only needs another look.'
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: Your name beside it, or just the shop?
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Elena is fine. Leave me room to change my mind.
clips.speaker: Elena

clips.sourceText: At the show, a visitor stops where the portrait would be.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: They stay longer than Marcus expected.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: I kept calling it a missing picture. It isn't missing now.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: Maybe. If she asks. I've got other things to ask her.
clips.speaker: Marcus

clips.sourceText: What you leave out can belong to someone, too.
clips.speaker: 出发之后

clips.sourceText: It is your last evening in Singapore for now.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Mei meets you for dinner. Your bag waits beside the chair.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Packed already? That is suspiciously organised.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Leaving people, or leaving the version of you here?
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Your unsent message begins: 'We should all meet again.'
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Or a budget. We are very good at imaginary holidays.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Work, study and distance have not disappeared.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Add the time zone. Affection doesn't convert clocks.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: That's a message someone can keep. Send that.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: You send it. There is no instant chorus of replies.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Different evenings. Different jobs. They will find it.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: You eat while the food is still hot.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: A little later, one reply arrives. Then another.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: One friend can make time. Another needs a different day.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Yes. There are actual people on the other end.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: You write a sentence and leave the next line empty.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Do I get to read it?
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Of course. Just let me move the soup out of the way.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: The first picture blurs. You keep the second.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Just for us. The internet can survive without dinner.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Outside, Mei waits while you adjust the strap on your bag.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: Message me when you arrive. No travel essay required.
clips.speaker: Mei

clips.sourceText: Tomorrow will not look like tonight. That is all right.
clips.speaker: 旁白

clips.sourceText: You can leave without making it the last time.
clips.speaker: 出发之后
